# Tallyhall v1.0.0

Tallyhall is expense management and accounts payable for finance teams who are tired of chasing receipts. Employees snap a receipt, managers approve from their phone, and finance closes the month without a spreadsheet in sight.

---

## Why Tallyhall

Most finance teams lose days every month to the same loop: an employee loses a receipt, an approver sits on a queue, and someone in finance re-keys card transactions into the accounting system. Tallyhall replaces that loop with one place where every expense arrives with its receipt attached, its policy checked, and its accounting codes already filled in.

---

## What's in v1.0.0

### 1. Capture anything

Snap a receipt on your phone, forward it by email, or drag a PDF into the web app. Tallyhall reads the merchant, date, total, and tax, and attaches it to the matching card transaction when there is one.

---

### 2. Connect your cards and banks

#### Corporate cards

Connect corporate card programs and transactions flow in daily, already assigned to the right employee.

#### Bank feeds

Connect business bank accounts to reconcile reimbursements and vendor payments.

#### Accounting systems

Two-way sync with your general ledger: chart of accounts, departments, classes, and vendors stay in step.

---

### 3. Approvals that move

Build approval chains by amount, department, or category. Approvers get a notification on their phone and can approve without opening a laptop.

---

### 4. Policy checks, automatically

Set limits per category, per diem rates, and receipt requirements once. Every expense is checked when it is submitted, and only the exceptions reach a human.

---

### 5. Reimburse on time

Approved expenses are batched into reimbursement runs that match your payroll calendar, and every employee can see exactly when they will be paid.

---

### 6. Pay vendor bills

Upload or email vendor invoices, route them for approval, and pay on schedule. Duplicate invoices are caught before they are paid.

---

### 7. Reports and exports

Spend by department, project, vendor, or employee, with exports to CSV and your accounting system.

---

### 8. Stay in control

Role-based access, a full audit trail on every expense, and single sign-on for the whole team.

---

## Supported cards & accounting systems

Major corporate card programs, business bank feeds in the US, Canada, and the EU, and the most common accounting systems for small and mid-sized companies.

### Approval tiers

Every company starts with a simple one-step approval and can add tiers by amount or department at any time.

---

## Getting started

Invite your finance team, connect one card program, and set your first policy. Most teams submit their first expense the same day.
